first_1.text: Stop there. The Warden hasn't spoken to anyone in my lifetime, and it picks an outsider?

choices.text: I don't know why it chose me. I'd like to help.
I'm only a guest here. I'll follow your rules.

honest.text: Hm, an honest answer. Those are rarer than strangers.

humble.text: Good. Rules kept us alive for three hundred years.

boast.text: Taste, wonderful. The sky is falling and I get a comedian.

first_2.text: Go on in, then. Tobbin's workshop is on the right, if the Warden wants you fed and tinkered at.

again_1.text: Still here? The workshop is on the right, follow the hammering.

choices.text: Thank you for letting me in.

place.text: Wreckhaven, built inside the bones of a ship that fell from the stars. Most days it feels like home.

trust_low.text: Because the last time the sky did something new, half the eastern isles fell. Earn it.

thanks.text: Don't thank me yet. Thank me when the islands stop sinking.

after_1.text: The Warden is awake, and the lanterns are brighter. I suppose that counts for something.

after_warm.text: Perhaps. Don't let it go to your head, Stranger.
